injury_reports.name: Nate Boerkircher
injury_reports.summary: Boerkircher (back) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Josh Cameron
injury_reports.summary: Cameron caught three of six targets for 43 yards during the Jaguars' 19-17 win over the Eagles on Sunday in London. He also returned one kickoff for 18 yards and added a tackle on special teams.

injury_reports.name: Travis Hunter
injury_reports.summary: Hunter recorded a nine-yard reception and tallied six tackles and a pass breakup in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles in London.

injury_reports.name: Trevor Lawrence
injury_reports.summary: Lawrence completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles. He added 25 rushing yards on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Jakobi Meyers
injury_reports.summary: Meyers caught two of three targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 19-17 win against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rodriguez rushed twice for five yards and caught his only target for six yards during Sunday's 19-17 win over Philadelphia.

injury_reports.name: Brenton Strange
injury_reports.summary: Strange caught seven of eight targets for 68 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thomas failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Bhayshul Tuten
injury_reports.summary: Tuten carried the ball 22 times for 72 yards and caught two of three targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Parker Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught six of nine targets for 124 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Montaric Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Eric Murray
injury_reports.summary: Murray (concussion) does not have an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Bryan Thomas Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thomas was ejected from Sunday's game in London after receiving an unnecessary roughness penalty for fighting with the Eagles' Jeremiah Trotter following the opening kickoff, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Little
injury_reports.summary: Little made both of his field goals and went 1-for-2 on extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 19-17 win over the Eagles on Sunday in London.

injury_reports.name: Ross Matiscik
injury_reports.summary: Matiscik (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Anton Harrison
injury_reports.summary: Harrison is slated to undergo arthroscopic surgery on his right knee next week and could be out for 3-to-5 weeks or 3-to-4 months, depending on what surgeons find while performing the procedure, Michael DiRocco and Ian Rapoport of ESPN report.

items.impact: Reported Out: CB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.impact: Reported Out: LS starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at OT may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Kayshon Boutte
injury_reports.summary: Boutte caught three of five targets for 38 yards during Sunday's 26-3 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Nico Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins caught five of seven targets for 56 yards in Sunday's 26-3 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans confirmed Wednesday that Harrison will make his team debut Sunday versus the Jaguars in London, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Hutchinson
injury_reports.summary: Hutchinson caught four of five targets for 65 yards in Sunday's 26-3 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Jawhar Jordan
injury_reports.summary: The Texans have elevated Jordan from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: Woody Marks
injury_reports.summary: Marks is expected to handle a lead role out of the backfield during Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London after Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans announced Monday that fellow running back David Montgomery (groin) is viewed as week-to-week, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: David Montgomery
injury_reports.summary: The Texans ruled Montgomery (groin) out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London.

injury_reports.name: Jaylin Noel
injury_reports.summary: Noel caught all five of his targets for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 26-3 win over Tennessee.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Schultz
injury_reports.summary: Schultz caught three of four targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 26-3 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Braden Smith
injury_reports.summary: The Texans activated Smith (foot) from their injured reserve list Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: C.J. Stroud
injury_reports.summary: Stroud completed 26 of 34 passes for 261 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-3 win over the Titans. He added five rushing yards and a TD on six carries.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Marcus Ingram
injury_reports.summary: The Texans activated Ingram (elbow) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Pitre
injury_reports.summary: Pitre (shoulder) is ruled out for Sunday's game against Jacksonville.

injury_reports.name: Henry To'oTo'o
injury_reports.summary: The Texans activated To'oTo'o (shoulder) from injured reserve Saturday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
injury_reports.summary: Fairbairn converted on all six of his kicks (four field goals, two extra points) during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Titans on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tank Dell
injury_reports.summary: The Texans ruled out Dell (knee) for Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London.

math: Model score: HOU 19.07, JAX 24.24. Market spread: -2.5.
Home cover edge = home score − away score + home spread = 2.66 points.
Team implied totals: JAX (41.5 − (-2.5)) / 2 = 22.00; HOU (41.5 + (-2.5)) / 2 = 19.50. Market scoring expectations are context only.
Price -118 implies 54.1%; no-vig market 51.7%.
Model win 57.8%, push 0.0%, loss 42.2%; conditional win 57.8%.
EV per unit = win × net payout − loss = 0.58 × 0.85 − 0.42 ≈ 0.07. Probability edge 6.1%.

injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson
injury_reports.summary: Dotson caught two of four passes for 54 yards during the Falcons' 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Austin Hooper
injury_reports.summary: Hooper caught his only target for nine yards during Monday's 45-24 win at New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Drake London
injury_reports.summary: London caught seven of 11 targets for 118 yards in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Jake Matthews
injury_reports.summary: Matthews (groin) is active for Sunday night's game against the Ravens, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Penix Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Penix (ribs) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Bears, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Pitts caught five of six targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Bijan Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson rushed 17 times for 86 yards while catching four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Robinson handled seven carries for 16 yards and did not catch his only target during Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss versus the Ravens. He also returned two kickoffs for 61 return yards.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Rush
injury_reports.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Ravens but will serve as the emergency quarterback, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tua Tagovailoa
injury_reports.summary: With Michael Penix (ribs) cleared to play Sunday against the Bears, Tagovailoa will handle backup duties for the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Yasir Abdullah
injury_reports.summary: The Falcons placed Abdullah (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Divine Deablo
injury_reports.summary: Deablo (hamstring) was a full participant at practice Thursday, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: C.J. Henderson
injury_reports.summary: Henderson (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Harold Perkins Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Perkins recorded 10 tackles (seven solo) including 0.5 sacks and a pass defensed during Monday's 45-24 win at New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Za'Darius Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bears, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Folk
injury_reports.summary: Folk converted all five of his kicks (three field goals, two extra points) during Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

items.name: C.J. Henderson
items.impact: Reported Out: CB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Za'Darius Smith
items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at DE may be affected.

items.name: Yasir Abdullah
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at LB may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Tyson Bagent
injury_reports.summary: Whether Bagent starts or serves in a backup role against the Falcons on Sunday depends largely on whether Caleb Williams (hamstring) is cleared to return from a three-game absence, Larry Mayer of the Bears' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Luther Burden III
injury_reports.summary: Burden secured four of six targets for 47 yards and rushed four times for two yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Case Keenum
injury_reports.summary: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Atlanta, but if he's not given the green light to return, then it's unclear whether Keenum or Tyson Bagent starts under center for Chicago, Larry Mayer of the Bears' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Colston Loveland
injury_reports.summary: Loveland brought in two of five targets for 19 yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_reports.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) was ruled out for Sunday's game in Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Rome Odunze
injury_reports.summary: Odunze brought in three of nine targets for 40 yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Kalif Raymond
injury_reports.summary: Raymond caught three of four passes for six yards and logged one carry for minus-2 yards during the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday. He also returned one punt for nine yards.

injury_reports.name: Zavier Scott
injury_reports.summary: The Bears have elevated Scott from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: D'Andre Swift
injury_reports.summary: Swift will once again absorb a heavier backfield workload after Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Larry Mayer of the Bears' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (hamstring) is expected to start Sunday's game against the Falcons, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Edwards
injury_reports.summary: Edwards (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Keyshaun Elliott
injury_reports.summary: Elliott (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Gordon
injury_reports.summary: The Bears activated Gordon (calf) from reserve/PUP on Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Noah Sewell
injury_reports.summary: Sewell (Achilles) is active for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson (hip) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Montez Sweat
injury_reports.summary: The NFL announced Tuesday that Sweat has been suspended two games without pay for violating the league's performance-enhancing substances policy, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Shemar Turner
injury_reports.summary: The Bears activated Turner (knee) from their reserve/PUP list Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Cairo Santos
injury_reports.summary: Santos missed his lone field-goal attempt and converted on his only PAT during the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dayo Odeyingbo
injury_reports.summary: The Bears placed Odeyingbo (quadriceps) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Johnson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: out

Team implied totals: CLE (39.5 − (3)) / 2 = 18.25; BAL (39.5 + (3)) / 2 = 21.25. Market scoring expectations are context only.
Price -108 implies 51.9%; no-vig market 49.6%.
Model win 50.8%, push 3.0%, loss 46.2%; conditional win 52.3%.

injury_reports.summary: The Eagles are signing Milton off the Cowboys' practice squad, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports.

injury_reports.summary: Pierce will be the Eagles' starting running back against the Panthers on Sunday due to the absences of both Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and Will Shipley (foot, IR).

injury_reports.summary: Smith (hamstring) practiced in full Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Jakorian Bennett

injury_reports.name: Landon Dickerson

injury_reports.name: Jermaine Eluemunor
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Malachi Fields
injury_reports.summary: Fields hauled in both of his targets for 20 yards during the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Commanders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Theo Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (neck) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Likely
injury_reports.summary: Likely caught 11 of 13 targets for 94 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: J.J. McCarthy
injury_reports.summary: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday he plans to keep using McCarthy in a change-of-pace role behind starting quarterback Jameis Winston in an effort to take advantage of McCarthy's scrambling ability, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Darnell Mooney
injury_reports.summary: Mooney (neck) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Malik Nabers
injury_reports.summary: Nabers caught 11 of 20 targets for 121 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: Cam Skattebo
injury_reports.summary: Skattebo rushed 13 times for 59 yards and caught two of three targets for 12 yards in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Jameis Winston
injury_reports.summary: Winston completed 33 of 54 passes for 326 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders. He also rushed five times for 27 yards and lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Abdul Carter
injury_reports.summary: Carter (calf) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Colton Hood
injury_reports.summary: Hood (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Nubin
injury_reports.summary: Nubin (neck) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Dru Phillips
injury_reports.summary: Phillips had five total tackles (five solo) and 2.0 sacks in Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: Jason Pinnock
injury_reports.summary: Pinnock (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Dominic Zvada
injury_reports.summary: Zvada went 2-for-5 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: Braxton Berrios
injury_reports.summary: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Chauncey Golston
injury_reports.summary: The Giants placed Golston (neck) on injured reserve Saturday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalon Daniels
injury_reports.summary: Daniels will be the Buccaneers' starting quarterback against the Steelers after Baker Mayfield (right thumb) was ruled out.

injury_reports.name: Emeka Egbuka
injury_reports.summary: Egbuka secured six of nine targets for 38 yards and rushed once for a 14-yard touchdown in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Kenny Gainwell
injury_reports.summary: Gainwell rushed four times for 18 yards and brought in three of four targets for 10 yards in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Godwin secured all three targets for 37 yards and rushed once for three yards in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: Ted Hurst III
injury_reports.summary: Hurst did not record a target during the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Bucky Irving
injury_reports.summary: Irving rushed 21 times for 165 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 10 yards and another score in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Tez Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught his lone target for 64 yards during Thursday's 24-16 win over the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Ko Kieft
injury_reports.summary: Kieft (elbow) does not carry an injury designation into Thursday's game against the Cowboys, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Baker Mayfield
injury_reports.summary: Mayfield (thumb) will not play Sunday, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Cade Otton
injury_reports.summary: Otton caught three of four targets for 25 yards in a 24-16 win over Dallas on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Easton Stick
injury_reports.summary: The Bucs have elevated Stick from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Sean Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker (quadriceps) is listed as questionable and considered a game-time decision for Sunday's matchup with Pittsburgh, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Josh Williams
injury_reports.summary: The Bucs elevated Williams from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Alex Anzalone

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Benjamin Morrison

injury_reports.name: Jacob Parrish

injury_reports.name: Josiah Trotter
injury_reports.summary: Trotter (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Winfield (ribs) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chase McLaughlin
injury_reports.summary: McLaughlin made his only field-goal attempt and all three extra-point tries Thursday in a 24-16 win against Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Davante Adams
injury_reports.summary: Adams brought in five of seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Davis Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (foot) does not have an injury designation against the Cardinals on Sunday, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Corum
injury_reports.summary: Corum rushed five times for 19 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 53 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Higbee
injury_reports.summary: Higbee brought in five of six targets for 83 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Alaric Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson's suspension for an act of unsportsmanlike conduct during Monday's game versus the Bills has been reduced to one game, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Puka Nacua
injury_reports.summary: Nacua brought in 17 of 24 targets for 138 yards and a touchdown and rushed twice for nine yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Colby Parkinson
injury_reports.summary: Parkinson (shoulder) doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Ty Simpson
injury_reports.summary: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Monday, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Stafford
injury_reports.summary: Stafford completed 40 of 54 passes for 383 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Keagen Trost
injury_reports.summary: The Rams activated Trost (hamstring) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Kyren Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown and brought in six of eight targets for 27 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kam Curl
injury_reports.summary: Curl (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Lake
injury_reports.summary: Lake (hip) is active for Monday's game against the Bills, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Nate Landman
injury_reports.summary: Landman (wrist/shoulder) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trent McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie (groin) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bills, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Grupe
injury_reports.summary: The Rams signed Grupe off the Jets' practice squad Tuesday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Myles Garrett
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Sean McVay told reporters Tuesday that Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week and will not play against the Cardinals on Sunday, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier is poised for a leading role out of the Cardinals backfield Sunday at the Rams with Jeremiyah Love (ankle) sidelined in Week 6, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Beck (coach's decision) is inactive and is designated as Arizona's emergency third quarterback for Sunday's matchup versus the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Bourne caught five of eight targets for 70 yards during Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Shawn Bowman
injury_reports.summary: Bowman was signed from the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Brissett completed 29 of 47 passes for 292 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 19 yards and a seven-yard reception on his only target in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks recorded two catches for 16 yards on seven targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Evan Hull
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals elevated Hull from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight will bump up the Cardinals' RB depth chart in Week 6 with Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: Love (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey McBride
injury_reports.summary: McBride brought in nine of 10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Teagan Quitoriano
injury_reports.summary: Quitoriano caught both of his targets for 15 yards and two touchdowns during Sunday's 45-21 loss to Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Reggie Virgil
injury_reports.summary: Virgil recorded two receptions for 29 yards on five targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson brought in four of seven targets for 30 yards and completed his only pass attempt for seven yards in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Budda Baker
injury_reports.summary: Baker (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Zaven Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kitan Crawford
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals activated Crawford (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: Nolen (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Wydett Williams Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Williams (concussion) for Sunday's game against the Rams, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Wingard
injury_reports.summary: Wingard (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Rams, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Gillikin
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland made all three of his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal try during the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

math: Model score: ARI 18.61, LA 29.98. Market spread: -12.5.
Home cover edge = home score − away score + home spread = -1.12 points.
Team implied totals: LA (51.5 − (-12.5)) / 2 = 32.00; ARI (51.5 + (-12.5)) / 2 = 19.50. Market scoring expectations are context only.
Price -108 implies 51.9%; no-vig market 49.6%.
Model win 53.7%, push 0.0%, loss 46.3%; conditional win 53.7%.
EV per unit = win × net payout − loss = 0.54 × 0.93 − 0.46 ≈ 0.03. Probability edge 4.1%.

injury_reports.name: Brock Bowers
injury_reports.summary: Bowers (knee) practiced fully Thursday. Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kirk Cousins
injury_reports.summary: Cousins completed 19 of 28 passes for 243 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Ashton Jeanty
injury_reports.summary: Jeanty (foot) was listed as a full participant on Wednesday's injury report, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Laube
injury_reports.summary: Laube rushed four times for nine yards and a touchdown while also reeling in all three of his targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 45-17 loss to New England.

injury_reports.name: Michael Mayer
injury_reports.summary: Mayer caught his only target for two yards during Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Fernando Mendoza
injury_reports.summary: Mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards without a touchdown or turnover in Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots. He added three yards on his only carry.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor (concussion) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jackson Powers-Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Powers-Johnson (groin) was a full participant in practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker caught four of five targets for 41 yards during Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington logged a five-yard carry and caught his lone target for five yards during the Raiders' 45-17 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Cody White
injury_reports.summary: White caught two of four passes for 44 yards during Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Trey Zuhn III
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tonka Hemingway
injury_reports.summary: Hemingway (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (stinger/neck) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Quay Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker registered six tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks, during the Raiders' 30-27 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Matt Gay
injury_reports.summary: Gay went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and converted both of his extra-point tries during the Raiders' 45-17 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Carter Runyon
injury_reports.summary: Runyon (lower body) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thornton (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Bills,  Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Josh Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen completed 12 of 19 passes for 210 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding 10 carries for 121 yards and another score and a two-point conversion pass in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Skyler Bell
injury_reports.summary: Bell will make his NFL regular-season debut against the Rams on Monday due to the absence of Joshua Palmer (shoulder), Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Keon Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman caught a seven-yard touchdown pass on two targets during the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday.

injury_reports.name: James Cook III
injury_reports.summary: Cook rushed 10 times for 121 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for seven yards in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night. He also committed two fumbles, losing one.

injury_reports.name: Ray Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis caught his lone target for 31 yards while adding two carries for two yards and three kickoff returns for 114 yards during the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Ty Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Kincaid
injury_reports.summary: Kincaid brought in one of two targets for seven yards and recorded a two-point conversion catch in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Dawson Knox
injury_reports.summary: Knox caught both of his targets for 13 yards in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: DJ Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (shoulder) will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Jay Skurski of The Buffalo News reports.

injury_reports.name: Joshua Palmer
injury_reports.summary: Palmer (shoulder) and DJ Moore (shoulder) are listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Khalil Shakir
injury_reports.summary: Shakir brought in all three targets for 80 yards in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Dee Alford
injury_reports.summary: Alford (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Benford
injury_reports.summary: Benford (toe) does not carry an injury designation into Monday night's game against the Rams, Joe Buscaglia of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Te'Cory Couch
injury_reports.summary: Couch suffered a hamstring injury Sunday versus New England and is doubtful to return.

injury_reports.name: Mike Danna
injury_reports.summary: Danna re-signed with the Bills on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Davison Igbinosun
injury_reports.summary: Even with Christian Benford (toe) back from injury, Igbinosun is still expected to have a role in the Bills' secondary for Monday's game against the Rams, Nick Suss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Landon Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.

injury_reports.name: Ed Oliver
injury_reports.summary: Oliver (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Greg Rousseau
injury_reports.summary: Rousseau logged four tackles (two solo) and two passes defensed in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Sanders
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tyler Bass
injury_reports.summary: Bass went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 29-26 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Cyrus Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen failed to reel in his only target in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Armstrong
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs have elevated Armstrong from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Noah Gray
injury_reports.summary: Gray caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Emmett Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught his lone target for 10 yards in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Travis Kelce
injury_reports.summary: Kelce caught two of four targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Mahomes
injury_reports.summary: Mahomes completed 15 of 30 passes for 225 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders. He also rushed twice for no gain.

injury_reports.name: Rashee Rice
injury_reports.summary: Rice (hamstring/knee) will not play Sunday against the Chargers, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

injury_reports.name: Josh Simmons
injury_reports.summary: Simmons (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III
injury_reports.summary: Walker rushed 22 times for 177 yards and two touchdowns while catching his only target for two yards in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Justin Watson
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs elevated Watson from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy
injury_reports.summary: Worthy will be the Chiefs' top wideout against the Chargers on Sunday due to the absence of Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee).

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton posted nine tackles (four solo) during the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chamarri Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner (knee) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Mansoor Delane
injury_reports.summary: Delane tallied 10 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense during the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injury_reports.summary: Sneed (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Butker converted his only field-goal attempt and all three of his PATs during Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Tyquan Thornton
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Johnston
injury_reports.summary: Johnston (chest) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Kolar
injury_reports.summary: Kolar reeled in three of four targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 23-17 loss versus the Broncos. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
injury_reports.summary: The Chargers activated Lambert-Smith (hamstring) from injured reserve Saturday, and he is questionable for Sunday's matchup versus Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Ladd McConkey
injury_reports.summary: McConkey (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Keaton Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell took six carries for 11 yards and caught three of four targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 23-17 loss versus the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Brenen Thompson
injury_reports.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Kimani Vidal
injury_reports.summary: Vidal tallied eight carries for 57 yards and one touchdown, one catch (on two targets) for minus-1 yard and returned three kicks for 75 yards during Sunday's 23-17 defeat to the Broncos.
